rows.en: First Step
rows.notes: Open mission title; katakana-English kept as natural English.

rows.en:
As part of training, hold a mock battle
against Destroids inside the Macross.

The giant battleship that fell from space brought humanity new knowledge and technology, and great upheaval, starting with the Unification Wars. Restored as the U.N. Forces battleship "Macross", it now carries OverTechnology's "Valkyrie" variable fighters. A mock battle aboard will double as a test run.
Annihilate all enemies
Booby Trap

Annihilate the giant aliens striking back
against the Macross's attack.

The Macross's restoration was finally complete, and its launch ceremony held. During it, an unknown space fleet was detected approaching, but the Macross's main cannon fired on the fleet by itself. The Macross had been an alien booby trap set for their enemies. And so, like it or not, war with the aliens began.
Countdown

Annihilate the giant aliens' ground forces
attacking the Macross. (No large units)
rows.notes: (No large units) = large-frame units cannot sortie; same rendering in every row of this slice.

rows.en: The Macross is under fierce attack from the giant aliens. To break the deadlock, it attempts to launch into space. But the enemy has also sent in ground forces, and launch preparations are getting nowhere. The giant aliens' ground forces must be driven back so the Macross can launch.
rows.notes: Who must repel the ground forces is unstated (passive kept).

rows.en: Space Fold

To ensure the Macross's fold succeeds,
annihilate the giant aliens interfering.

The Macross escaped to space for now, but the giant aliens kept up the attack, and the space carriers ARMD-1 and ARMD-2 were destroyed just before joining it. To break this desperate situation, Capt. Global decides to fake a descent to Earth and fold to the Moon's far side instead.
rows.notes: ARMD-1/ARMD-2 follow the JP numbering (glossary: ARMD-class space carrier).

rows.en: Transformation

Annihilate the enemy within the time limit
and clear the Macross main cannon's line of fire.

The fold succeeded, but the Macross emerged in Pluto's orbit, and the fold system vanished as well. Another fold is now impossible, and on top of that, even the main cannon is unusable. Still, the alien fleet keeps up its relentless pursuit. The only way to drive it off is to risk a transformation and fire the main cannon.
Protect the defense target
Survive for the set time
Defend Successfully
Average Rookie
rows.notes: Open mission title; katakana-English kept as natural English.

rows.en:
As the volunteers' final test, hold a
mock battle. (No large units)

The enemy was barely driven off, but with the fold system gone, the Macross must return to Earth by conventional travel. With continued battles against the giant aliens judged unavoidable on the long voyage, volunteers were sought among its citizens. A mock battle will train them and gauge their skill.
rows.notes: Who judged / called for volunteers is unstated (passive kept).

rows.en: Defeat Enemy Ace Fast
rows.notes: tm was 'Defeat Ace Fast'; restored 'Enemy' (JP has it) to match u0277 'Defeat Enemy Ace'.

rows.en: Daedalus Attack

To set up the Daedalus Attack, act as a
decoy and draw the giant aliens' attention.

The Macross had only been on the defensive, but Capt. Global decides on a surprise attack near Saturn to wipe out the enemy fleet with a main cannon salvo. But the cannon fails to fire, perhaps from poor upkeep, putting the ship in danger instead. To escape, Lt. Hayase's "Daedalus Attack" plan must succeed at all costs.
Bye-Bye Mars

To get supplies, bring the
containers to the designated point.

After repeated battles, the Macross is in need of supplies. Sara Base on Mars has already been abandoned, but the Macross heads for Mars in search of the supplies that are likely still there. Enemy pursuit is expected, but without supplies, even getting back to Earth is in doubt.
Recover the containers
Longest Birthday

Shoot down Quamzin's unit, which has
launched a surprise attack on the Macross.

After battles with the giant aliens and a long voyage, the Macross has finally come within a step of Earth. But the giant aliens' powerful jamming has let an enemy warship close in on the Macross. To reach Earth safely, it must shake off the enemy pursuit at all costs.
Blind Game

Defend the Cat's Eye until the recon
of the giant aliens is complete.

With Earth in sight but unable to shake its pursuers, the Macross asks U.N. Forces HQ for backup, but HQ orders it to wear the enemy down as much as it can -- in effect, to buy time. Then a strange message comes: the enemy demands surrender! Lt. Hayase takes off in the Cat's Eye recon plane to learn its real aim.
First Contact

Infiltrate the enemy ship to rescue
the recon team. (No large units)

The Cat's Eye recon plane carrying Lt. Hayase was captured by the enemy, and contact is lost with 2nd Lt. Ichijyo and the other Valkyries sent to save her. Their survival is unconfirmed, but they can't be left to die, and a rescue should also yield valuable intel. A plan to infiltrate the enemy ship and rescue them is drawn up.
Reach the target point
Big Escape

The enemy ship the team infiltrated folded far from the Macross, but Lt. Hayase's group was rescued. They say the aliens, who call themselves Zentradi, know only war and chase the Macross out of interest in and fear of human culture. Now an enemy ship that seems set to launch for the Macross has been found.
Blue Wind

To break the encirclement and reach Earth,
annihilate the Zentradi forces.

The enemy ship that folded out was indeed headed for the Macross. The rescue team escaped it and came back safely with Lt. Hayase's group. Their shocking report told of an enemy of unimaginable size and strange nature, and a hopeless gap in strength. Still, Capt. Global resolves to break the siege and return to Earth.
Kung Fu Dandy

Defeat Quamzin's forces, which have
attacked the Macross.

Back on Earth after a year, the Macross still has no landing permit from U.N. Forces HQ. With the ground right there yet unable to leave the ship, the citizens grow ever more discontent. Meanwhile, Quamzin, chafing at orders against rash moves on the Macross, defies them and attacks it.
Defeat Milia's Unit
Pineapple Salad

To keep the enemy from nearing the Macross,
drive them back. (No large units)

As the Macross takes on supplies at sea, a Zentradi warship rapidly closes in. It is Milia's unit; she has heard from Quamzin that "the Macross has a crack pilot too." Busy resupplying, the Macross cannot move. The enemy must be driven back so the resupply can finish safely.
rows.notes: Milia is female (glossary); 'unit' here = her squad. Who must drive the enemy back is unstated (passive kept).

rows.en: Burst Point

To let the civilians land, annihilate the
Zentradi forces. (No large units)

Seeking a place for its civilians, the Macross is granted permission by the Ontario Autonomous Zone to take them in. The ship rejoices at the news, but the Zentradi forces appear as if to stop it. Annihilate the Zentradi forces at all costs so the civilians can be taken in.
Drop Out

So the Daedalus Attack isn't disrupted,
annihilate the enemy. (No large units)

U.N. Forces Supreme HQ concluded that the Zentradi's target was the Macross, not Earth, and launched the Macross back into space. Attacked by numerous Zentradi fleets, the Macross tries to escape the crisis by destroying enemy ships one by one with the Daedalus Attack.
Virgin Road

Annihilate the Zentradi forces
launching an all-out attack.

With the Daedalus Attack turned against it, the Macross was invaded by many enemy units, but some of them wanted to defect. To the Zentradi, who knew only war, Earth culture was an immeasurable culture shock. Alarmed, Boddole Zer, commander of the Zentradi main fleet, launched an all-out attack on the Macross.
Keep Allies Alive
Love Drifts Away

To push on to Boddole Zer's flagship,
annihilate the Zentradi forces.

With many defecting, Vrlitwhai chose a ceasefire and sent archivist Exsedol to the Macross. He says main fleet commander Boddole Zer will likely erase the Macross and Vrlitwhai's Culture-tainted men alike. To beat such hopeless odds, song must deliver a culture shock, and the flagship must be hit in the chaos.
rows.notes: 'archivist' for kiroku sanbou (record-keeping staff officer, Exsedol's post); 'his men' for Vrlitwhai-tachi.

rows.en: Do You Remember Love?

To end the interstellar war, defeat main
fleet commander Boddole Zer. (No large units)

Minmay's song dealt the Zentradi forces a culture shock, throwing their chain of command into confusion, if only for a while. This confusion must be used to defeat Boddole Zer, commander of the Zentradi main fleet, and end the war with the Zentradi.
rows.notes: Who must exploit the confusion is unstated (passive kept).

rows.en: Defeat Golg Boddole Zer
Combat Training
rows.notes: Open mission title; katakana-English kept as natural English.

rows.en:
Win the hand-to-hand combat training.
(No large units)

For the warrior-race Zentradi, daily combat drills are vital. Hand-to-hand combat without mobile weapons, above all, is both the basis of fighting and the last resort. Winning hand-to-hand drills is also a mark of status for a Zentradi.
Supply Block
rows.notes: Open mission title; katakana-English kept as natural English.

rows.en: Destroy all enemy supplies.

The Micronian battleship we're chasing seems about to stop at the red planet. Our advance party found an unmanned base there; the enemy likely plans to resupply. If we exploit an opening to destroy the supplies, the ship should be easy to take.
rows.notes: Zentradi-side briefing: subject restored as 'we' (Zentradi forces).

rows.en: Destroy the containers
Skull Leader

To capture a Micronian sample,
launch a diversionary attack.

The recon team sent to investigate near the Micronian battleship has returned, but could not bring back any concrete records. Even their direct reports were full of baffling content, and no useful intel was gained. To advance the investigation, we will launch a diversionary attack and capture Micronians to serve as samples.
Defeat Enemy Ace
